description: Signed Tree Head signing message (#39/#210/#531, decoupled per #774). A node signs (tree_size, root_hash, network_id, created_at) under a fixed domain tag with fixed-width big-endian integers and an explicit length prefix on root_hash. A client verifies a network's claimed identity by checking this signature against a pinned trust anchor, and a managed-hosting integrator signs a prepared tree head locally with a key the host never holds — both of which mean a client-side reimplementation that must match the node's byte for byte.

notSupported.csharp: languages/csharp/AvalonSdk/Network.cs verifies Signed Tree Heads against pinned trust anchors (VerifyNetworkAsync), but its conformance test does not consume this vector yet, so the signing-message bytes are not pinned against it in C#. A coverage gap, not a missing feature.
notSupported.typescript: languages/typescript/src/network/sthMessage.ts builds the signing message (signingMessage) and verifyNetwork.ts verifies against pinned trust anchors, but its conformance test does not consume this vector yet, so the signing-message bytes are not pinned against it in TypeScript. A coverage gap, not a missing feature.
